newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends steady on Japanese buying.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends steady on Japanese buying.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.10 ringgit ($5.63) a kg, after a brief trading session as both bids and offers were matched at the opening level, traders said.
Traders noted strong demand from Japanese buyers. There was also some buying from Europe and Malaysia, they said.
"The market was steady despite a slight drop in London, because of good demand here," said a trader.
Turnover was 100 tonnes, up from 90 tonnes on Monday.
The local price premium over the London Metal Exchange (LME) widened slightly to $75 a tonne from $70 previously.
